designDecisions: VENUS_REF = Venus's REAL preset read-slots (grounding Q2a; driver-presets.js:47). READ-SURFACE-MATCHED (finding 1): the flat slots {volatileFraction:0.02, massGravity:0.815/0.95²≈0.90304709} + the NESTED condition slots {T_eq:737 (surface temp), age:4.5 (no age field → deriveConditionVector default, body-condition-vector.js:26)}. EXACTNESS IS LOAD-BEARING (finding 2): VENUS_REF.massGravity is the EXACT live-derived Venus g (0.815/0.95², NOT the rounded 0.903), because unlike MAGMA_REF (synthetic-neutral OFF the real Lava/Magma vectors so those presets responded), VENUS_REF sits ON the shipped Venus preset in the 75-golden (captured 7441c92, NEVER re-captured) — a rounded-vs-live g mismatch would be inert only while gravity is deferred (K_G=0, designDecision #7) but would move the golden the instant the K_G opt-in fires. Authored as a frozen literal (NOT imported from driver-presets.js — base/ writers take no cross-imports; MAGMA_REF is likewise a literal, magmatism.js:93); AC-TUNE-NULL asserts exact equality of every read slot AGAINST the actually-constructed live Venus bundle so any VENUS_REF-vs-live drift surfaces at the unit layer, not as an unexplained golden break. We do NOT introduce a documented-neutral-off-Venus point (that would move the golden). See AC-TUNE-NULL + AC-BYTE-VENUS.

Population-knobs-ONLY mapping (grounding Q2b/Q2d): stagnantDriversToTune re-tunes ONLY the placement/population knobs — TESSERA_FRAC (stagnantLid.js:49), CORONA_ACTIVE_FRAC (:53), CORONA_POOL (:51), PLUME_MIN (:46) — and leaves the BASE_TESSERA/BASE_PLAINS/BASE_RIFT floors (:62) + all amplitude constants byte-identical to Venus. Primary axes are V (volatiles/dryness) + T_surf per ROADMAP-v2 §2.3 / R-wetstag / §5.4 #1; secondary thermalState/age (corona activity/resurfacing). Each transfer function is anchored on a deviation-from-VENUS_REF signal so it evaluates to the exact DEFAULT at VENUS_REF (mirrors magmatism.js:117 Hd = H − H_REF). GROUNDING, PRECISELY (finding 3 — corrected: the MECHANISM doc does NOT contain a directional sign law): the STATIC STRUCTURES + calibrated fractions (tessera plateaus, active/inactive coronae, resurfacing-age plains, the 0.075/0.65 fractions) are grounded in increment-4b-venus-stagnantlid-MECHANISM.md, which EXPLICITLY DEFERS driver-response ('seed-only (driver-response deferred to the tune/drivers seam)', MECHANISM.md:586). The DIRECTIONAL SIGNS (drier/older → ↑preserved tessera; younger/hotter → ↑active coronae; more vigor → ↑coronae/plumes) are the scoper's FIRST-CUT physical reasoning anchored to ROADMAP-v2 §2.3's V-axis semantics ('dry → won't recycle → stagnant'), UAT-tunable per designDecision #8 — NOT claimed as MECHANISM-doc sign law. See AC-TUNE-RESPONSE.

Null-guard THEN exact-only identity guard (grounding Q2c; mirror magmatism.js:114 + :124-127): (i) NULL-GUARD FIRST (must-fix, byte-safety lens) — stagnantDriversToTune(null) and stagnantDriversToTune({}) return null (mirror magmatism.js:114 'if (drivers == null) return null'), REQUIRED because the dispatch calls stagnantDriversToTune(bodyDrivers) with bodyDrivers defaulting null (planet-lod-rivers.js:452) and the shipped stagnant structure tests (worldengine-base-stagnantlid-structure.test.js:340,:368) reach the dispatch with bodyDrivers===null — without the guard null.volatileFraction throws and crashes two green tests. (ii) EXACT-ONLY IDENTITY GUARD — stagnantDriversToTune returns null iff every computed override === its DEFAULT. Because the signals are deviation-from-VENUS_REF, at VENUS_REF every override collapses to its DEFAULT → return null → the writer's `tune ? {...DEFAULTS,...tune} : DEFAULTS` ternary (stagnantLid.js:175) takes the untouched DEFAULTS branch → byte-identical Venus. This is the increment-2 byte-identity discipline (exact-only, like plates' D_EARTH). See AC-TUNE-NULL.

Anti-mush is STRUCTURAL, not a bound (grounding Q2d): because the BASE_* floors (0.70/0.10/−0.45, gaps 0.60/0.55) + all amplitudes are UNTOUCHED, the ordering invariant mean(tessera) > mean(plains) > mean(rift) holds by construction — identical floors to the proven Venus field, with every amplitude < its (unchanged) gap (stagnantLid.js:62-63 comments). Re-tuning HOW MANY tessera/corona provinces appear cannot invert WHERE the floors sit. See AC-ORDER-PRESERVED.

Threaded at the SHIPPED dispatch seam, NOT the router (grounding Q3; planet-lod-rivers.js:489-491, mirroring the volcanic wiring :481-483): the edit passes bodyDrivers (in scope at writeBodyRelief :452 — and it carries its NESTED .condition, the sanctioned T_surf/age read surface documented at writeBodyRelief:449-451) + tune: stagnantDriversToTune(bodyDrivers) + sets stagnantDiag.appliedTune. grainDrivers is no longer the drivers arg on the stagnant path (byte-safe — the writer `void drivers`, stagnantLid.js:174, exactly as #4-M dropped it on the volcanic path). The V2-2a router (lidResponse.js) is NOT edited → byte-identical; the router will thread the stagnant tune at V2-3 (out of scope). magmatism.js + lidResponse.js stay byte-identical (AC-ZERO-CLOBBER for the still-shipped corner paths); V2-2a's AC-BYTE-STRONG-REF (Venus through the router, tune omitted → DEFAULTS) stays green.

T_surf + age source = NESTED bodyDrivers.condition (grounding Q7#1; FLIPPED per finding 1 — MUST-FIX): stagnantDriversToTune reads T_surf from drivers.condition?.T_eq ?? 737 and age from drivers.condition?.age ?? 4.5 (OPTIONAL-CHAINING + VENUS_REF fallback per the byte-safety lens should-fix — a condition-less bundle degrades to Venus defaults → deviations 0 → byte-safe null, NEVER throws, mirroring magma's never-throw ?? discipline magmatism.js:99-102; buildNeutralBodyDrivers body-drivers.js:22-25 returns only flat keys and does NOT attach .condition, so the golden/lab callers attach it but a bare flat bundle must degrade not crash), with V=drivers.volatileFraction and g=drivers.massGravity from the FLAT bundle. WHY NESTED (not the earlier flat-surfacing recommendation): (1) condition is ALREADY attached by buildBodyDrivers and is the sanctioned Slice-C D-slot read surface (writeBodyRelief:449-451: 'the V2-1 E1 read surface … the tune builders read only flat keys and ignore it') — so this needs ZERO new plumbing. (2) FLAT surfacing would have edited the SHARED body-drivers.js buildNeutralBodyDrivers (which also feeds the volcanic AC1 byte-identity harness) + buildBodyDrivers in planet-lod-lab.html — body-drivers.js is in NEITHER the allowlist nor the denylist, so AC-ZERO-CLOBBER(d)'s `git show --stat` audit would FAIL, and it would violate the codebase's documented R1 byte-safety discipline (body-condition-vector.js:12: 'a FLAT age would re-drive magmaThermal … nesting keeps condition.age invisible'; T_eq is surfaced NESTED for exactly this reason). (3) The nested read keeps the age limb REACHABLE (buildNeutralBodyDrivers:24 omits age from the flat bundle entirely). Byte-safety is unaffected: byte-identity is guaranteed by stagnantDriversToTune(Venus)===null (all deviations 0 at VENUS_REF), not by flat-vs-nested. The lab's NEW T_surf control overlays condition.T_eq (a planet-lod-lab.html edit, allowlisted); the existing volatiles slider already drives V. This is a MIXED flat+nested read by design; AC-0's driver-connectivity wording is corrected to accept the condition.{T_eq,age} surface. THERMALSTATE AGE-SOURCE (byte-safety lens note): thermalState reads FLAT and buildNeutralBodyDrivers omits any flat age (body-drivers.js:22-25) → thermalState always sees the age=4.5 fallback, so the AGE lever moves ONLY tessera (via nested condition.age), NOT activeFrac; activeFrac responds to thermalState's tidal term + T_surf. So 'younger → higher activeFrac' is carried by thermalState/T_surf and the age effect is the tessera limb — internally consistent + byte-safe (Venus thermalState ~0.275 either way).

Gravity relief-scaling DEFERRED / opt-in (grounding Q2d/Q7#5): 'higher g → flatter' would require touching relief amplitudes; the only ordering-safe form is a UNIFORM-PROPORTIONAL multiply on {BASE_* + all amplitudes} (a uniform scale keeps every gap positive + every amplitude below its scaled gap). RECOMMEND shipping it opt-in behind a zeroable K_G (default 0) so the anti-mush invariant stays trivially true (floors fixed) for the core increment. BYTE-GOLDEN CAVEAT (finding 2): while K_G=0 the g slot feeds NO override, so VENUS_REF.massGravity's exact value is inert. The instant the K_G opt-in fires, VENUS_REF.massGravity MUST equal the EXACT live-derived Venus g (0.815/0.95²≈0.90304709, NOT rounded 0.903) — otherwise the g-deviation at live-Venus is nonzero → a non-null tune at Venus → the 75-golden MOVES. So the opt-in ships together with the exact-g assertion in AC-TUNE-NULL. OPEN FOR MAX: gravity relief-scaling in-scope vs deferred.

Transfer gains first-cut, UAT-tunable (grounding Q7#3): K_TESS/K_ACT/K_POOL/K_PLUME are first-cut (mirror #4-M's K_COUNT/K_HEIGHT/K_LO/K_ELONG, magmatism.js:107), tunable at UAT before the province mix reads over-busy — Max's taste call. Not a straitjacket; the AC asserts monotone correct SIGN + measurable magnitude, not a fixed gain.

acceptanceCriteria.statement: THE MULTIPLY CORE — monotone correct-sign, MEASURABLE between-world response (mirror #4-MULTIPLY AC2; the fix for 'every stagnant world is a re-rolled Venus'). At a FIXED macroSeed, sweeping the primary drivers V (dryness) and T_surf (+ secondary thermalState/age) produces monotone correct-sign, measurable changes in the stagnant expressions read arm's-length from the diag: drier V + older age → ↑ tesseraFrac (more preserved ancient crust); younger/hotter (higher thermalState / T_surf) → ↑ activeFrac (more active coronae) + ↑ coronaCount; more vigor → ↑ plumeCount. At VENUS_REF the field collapses to Venus (AC-BYTE-VENUS). No inversion of any sign across the sweep. SCOPE OF THE T_surf LAW (finding 3): the 'hotter T_surf → ↑activeFrac' monotonicity is asserted ONLY on Venus's HOT-DRY LIMB (the pure-strong corner this tune expresses — Venus sits on it), NOT as a global T_surf law, so it does NOT contradict ROADMAP-v2 §2.3's requirement that L be NON-MONOTONIC in surface temperature across the whole V×T_surf space (the cold-thick-z limb is a different corner, out of this MULTIPLY's scope). The sweep therefore stays within the hot-dry limb (T_surf swept downward from 737 toward the wetter-cooler stagnant edge, not across the non-monotonic turning point). GROUNDING (per designDecision #2): the STRUCTURES/fractions are grounded in increment-4b-MECHANISM.md (which defers driver-response, :586); the directional SIGNS are §2.3's V-axis + first-cut physical reasoning, UAT-tunable — the AC asserts correct SIGN + measurable magnitude, not a MECHANISM-doc sign law.

verifyVia.input: Fix macroSeed; build the field at a monotone sweep of driver vectors ALONG THE HOT-DRY LIMB (VENUS_REF → drier / wetter / younger / older, T_surf stepped downward from 737 within the limb, not across the §2.3 non-monotonic turning point), reading tesseraFrac, coronaCount, activeFrac, plumeCount from the diag at each; rebuild every predictor arm's-length from the published plumeCenters
